newsitem.title: USA: Dole spokesman retracts earlier concession.
newsitem.headline: Dole spokesman retracts earlier concession.

text.p: A spokesman for Republican presidential challenger Bob Dole conceded defeat on Tuesday before polls closed in many Western states, but he later retracted the statement, saying it was premature.
"The fact is Bob Dole has conceded nothing," Dole spokesman Nelson Warfield said in a statement, adding that an earlier concession of defeat had been "prematurely released to some news outlets."
The earlier statement, which also bore Warfield's name, clearly said that Dole had lost the White House race.
"Bob Dole has completed his last political mission with courage and honour," the earlier statement read.

"Even in defeat, he has much to claim in the way of success. Bob Dole led his party in this election representing trust and conservative principles. With Republicans headed toward retaining the leadership of Congress, this country on the broadest front endorsed what Bob Dole stood for."
